title: Agent platform UX/design deep research and redesign

phases.label: Web-first deep research
phases.bottleneck_notes: Required collecting AI UX, dashboard, data table, visual hierarchy, and alert guidance before implementation.

phases.label: Requirements and specs
phases.bottleneck_notes: Paired Korean/English requirements, specs, research, and history artifacts took substantial time.

phases.label: Workspace Monitor UI implementation
phases.bottleneck_notes: Overview layout needed to preserve existing filters and sections while adding command-center hierarchy.

phases.label: Desktop UX artifact redesign
phases.bottleneck_notes: Reworked the HTML artifact from first-run steps into a product UX spine.

phases.label: Verification and visual smoke
phases.bottleneck_notes: Build and Playwright screenshot smoke were required to catch layout and overflow issues.

notes: Durations are approximate because timing started after the task was already underway.
The slowest phase was web-first deep research; future UX iterations can reuse the saved report.
